title: Practice: The family of свет (освети́ть, свеча)

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to light, to light up, to illuminate
candle (a light source, usually of wax)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: свет — light; освети́ть — to light, to light up, to illuminate; свеча — candle (a light source, usually of wax); рассве́т — dawn, daybreak.

exercises.why: **освещением** — освеще́ние: lighting; illumination; elucidation; coverage (e.g. in the press). Wiktionary: освети́ть + -е́ние.

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: свети́ться — to shine, to glow; све́чка — a small candle; свети́ть — to shine; освеще́ние — lighting; illumination.
**осветилось** — освети́ться (perfective): to light up, to brighten. Wiktionary: освети́ть + -ся.

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: свети́ло — heavenly body, celestial body, lamp; светя́щийся — luminous, lambent, lucent; свети́льник — lamp, light fixture; света́ть — (impersonal) to dawn.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: clear space, ray of light (in the clouds)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: о́тсвет — reflection, reflected light, glow, gleam; освети́ться — to light up, to brighten; светово́й — (relational) light; просве́т — clear space, ray of light (in the clouds).
